summary: Wednesday closed with a defensive tilt: consumer staples far outran tech, long Treasuries extended a sharp rally that pushed bond duration sentiment into greed, and gold's momentum stayed soft even as equity volatility edged up. Bitcoin held above its 200-day trend despite a volatility spike, keeping crypto sentiment in greed.
tweet: Staples crushed tech and long bonds kept rallying Wednesday, tilting sentiment defensive while crypto stayed in greed despite a volatility jump.
